title: Anyone at the Theater last night?
content: I woke up to such a vivid last few minutes of my mall world dream. Last night the theater was completely packed and I was sitting in the back as they showed the Shrek 5 dream world trailer. I shouted “look like it sucks!” Some others chanted in agreeing then I said “save your money and watch it at home!” I remember then a few people were talking to me. Just curious is anyone else was there or remembers this in their dream as it seemed to be filled with others from mall world.
